metadata.title: एक पुलिया को तरसता आदिवासी गांव | A tribal village remains isolated for last 300 year
metadata.description:
In the remote village of Yakhrai Kami, nestled in the Gomti district of Tripura, the Jamatia tribe has carved out a humble existence for over three centuries. Despite its rich history, the village remains isolated from the rest of the world, as if untouched by time. Its lack of a proper road and absence of a bridge across the river have created a formidable barrier for its residents.
With every election, hope resurfaces among the villagers as political parties promise to construct a bridge connecting them to the outside world. However, as the years pass, these promises become mere echoes, leaving the villagers disheartened and trapped in their seclusion.
The story of Yakhrai Kami becomes a symbol of forgotten promises and neglected communities, shedding light on the larger issue of infrastructure development in remote areas. It serves as a poignant reminder of the power of perseverance and the urgent need for action to bridge the gap between marginalized communities and the rest of society.
